description: List the tables staged on a canvas and their columns (name and type) so you can write correct SQL for gnomad_dataframe_query. Use the canvas_id returned by gnomad_list_gene_variants or gnomad_search_clinvar. Returns one entry per table with its row count and column schema.

canvas_id.description: Canvas ID returned by a prior staging call (gnomad_list_gene_variants or gnomad_search_clinvar).

name: gnomad_dataframe_describe

error.description: Present when the call failed. Absent on success.

code.description: JSON-RPC error code for this failure.

reason.description: Machine-readable failure mode. Declared by this tool: `canvas_disabled`: DataCanvas is not enabled on this server instance. Other values are possible when a failure originates below the handler.

recovery.description: Actionable next step for the caller.

message.description: Human-readable description of what went wrong.

items.description: One staged table: name, row count, and column schema.
One column: name and SQL type.

name.description: Table name to reference in SQL.

row_count.description: Number of rows in the table.

title: gnomad-genetics-mcp-server: dataframe describe
